issues.detail: Living-room south wall (y=13.545) is not hatched; the two W1 openings appear ~1.5 m wide on AR-08 versus W1 frame 1.00 m on AR-26. Positions taken from tag centres.

resolution.text: W1 = frame 1.00 x 2.50 per AR-26 (DEC-01 rule).

issues.title: Wall thickness derivation
issues.detail: Walls are drawn as 0.24pt grey 45deg hatch over the brick core (measured 0.06-0.08 m) with black plaster face lines 0.01-0.02 m outside. Finished thickness = hatch core + 0.03 m (≈0.10 m single wall). Two adjacent hatch bands < 0.06 m apart are merged into one thick wall (e.g. grid 1 at living room ≈0.19 m, stair west wall ≈0.20 m).

issues.title: Open-plan room boundaries
issues.detail: รับแขก / โถงรับประทานอาหาร / ครัวฝรั่ง / โถงต้อนรับ share one space without walls; ครัวไทย / ซักล้าง likewise. Dividing lines (grid 4 x=10.955, x=13.455, grid B y=8.545, y=3.05) are drawn only to hold the room tags and are NOT walls. โถง (L2) is open to the stair and void.

issues.title: Non-standard wall heights
issues.detail: Default wall heights are verified from sections (L1 3.60 = +0.65 to +4.25; L2 3.10 = +4.25 to +7.35). Kitchen block, double-height foyer/stair front wall, porch piers and garage-store walls have no section - heights shown are placeholders flagged Unverified.

resolution.text: Window W7 = 0.95 x 0.40 (table).

issues.title: Folding door D7 / D7.1 width
issues.detail: AR-26 gives width as '2.40/2.50' and size '2.00 x 2.40-2.50' for both. Exact per-door width not stated.

issues.title: North direction
issues.detail: Derived from AR-07 north arrow and building orientation; plan +Y (A->F) points ~NE. Needs user confirmation.

resolution.text: North direction derived from AR-07 confirmed: 130.8 deg clockwise from sheet-up on AR-08 (plan +Y bears ~49 deg, NE).

issues.title: Grid 5 → 5" spacing
issues.detail: Measured on AR-11 the grid bubbles 4, 4", 5, 5" sit at 2.00 / 3.00 / 1.00 spacing (same as AR-08). The 2.40/2.60/1.20 chain references wall/edge lines, not grid 4". Not treated as a grid conflict - please confirm.

issues.title: ST-04 chain 1.90 / 2.10 between grid 3 and 4
issues.detail: References the beam line at x=8.90 (also on AR-09 as 0.20+1.70), not grid 3" (x=10.00). Consistent.

issues.title: Plan opening gaps are systematically wider than scheduled widths
issues.detail: Measured clear gaps between hatched jambs on AR-08/AR-09: D2 1.12-1.33 m vs 0.90; D5 1.02-1.04 vs 0.80; W2/W2A/W5 0.84-0.93 vs 0.60. The offset (+0.22-0.27 m) is consistent, which suggests the plan shows the rough masonry opening while AR-26/AR-27 give frame (วงกบ) sizes. Opening positions (centres) are reliable; the width used in the model is always the scheduled one. Needs a decision before Phase 2 (keep schedule size, or model the rough opening).

resolution.text: Door/window sizes = frame (วงกบ) sizes from AR-26 / AR-27. The wider plan gap is the masonry opening and is not modelled.

decisions.decision: North direction derived from AR-07 confirmed: 130.8 deg clockwise from sheet-up on AR-08 (plan +Y bears ~49 deg, NE).
decisions.effect: North status Verified.

decisions.decision: Bathroom floors: L1 +0.55, L2 +4.15 (room tags on AR-08/AR-09); L2 bathroom ceiling C1 +2.60. The 'F2 +0.50 / C2 +2.40' tags on AR-09 are stray copies from an L1 bathroom detail.
decisions.effect: Reason: +0.55 and +4.15 are both exactly 0.10 m below their floor level (FFL1 +0.65, FFL2 +4.25), the usual wet-room drop. +0.50 on L2 would sit 3.75 m below the L2 floor, which is physically impossible.

decisions.decision: Foyer (โถงต้อนรับ) ceiling = 6.60 m above floor.
decisions.effect: Reason: AR-08 and AR-11 room tags plus the AR-12 ระดับฝ้า label all read +6.60; only the AR-12 room tag reads +5.80. Check: +0.65 + 6.60 = +7.25, just under the roof beam at +7.35.

decisions.decision: Garage grids are named 4 (x=11.00) and 5" (x=17.00); the bottom bubbles '3' and "4'" are aliases.
decisions.effect: Reason: the positions agree on all sheets. The top labels match the full dimension chain 1…5"; '3' already exists at x=7.00.

decisions.decision: Stair landing absolute level +2.45; the '+1.80' label means 1.80 m above FFL1.
decisions.effect: Reason: 10 risers x 0.18 = 1.80 from FFL1 +0.65, and AR-29 dimensions 1.80 from floor 1. Absolute +1.80 would need 6.4 risers.

decisions.decision: Door D3 = 2.00 x 1.00 (leaf), frame 1.10.
decisions.effect: Reason: the table's '0.10' is a typo. The elevation dims read 1.00/1.10, and the plan gap measures 1.22 m (fits a 1.10 frame).

decisions.decision: Window heights from the dimensioned elevations: W2 2.50 (sill 0.30), W2B 1.60 (sill 1.10 above L2 beam level +4.10), W2C 1.70 (sill 0.30), W9 1.20.
decisions.effect: Reason: the table rows for W2/W2B/W2C repeat the identical '2.05 x 0.60', which looks like a copied row, while each elevation is individually dimensioned. Check: W2 head 0.30 + 2.50 = 2.80 = L1 ceiling (DEC-02); W2B head +6.80 < L2 ceiling +7.25; W2C head 2.00 ≈ door head.

decisions.decision: Window W7 = 0.95 x 0.40 (table).
decisions.effect: Reason: arithmetic check — head 2.05 - sill 1.65 = 0.40, which equals the table value. The 0.30 dimension on the elevation is the glazed sash.

decisions.decision: Tag 'B2' on AR-09 = W2B.
decisions.effect: Reason: no type 'B2' exists, and with it the W2B count = 3 = schedule qty.

decisions.decision: Model all 10 D2 openings drawn on the plans; schedule qty 8 treated as out of date.
decisions.effect: Reason: plans govern location and count; every D2 sits in a drawn opening with a swing.

decisions.decision: Porch (เฉลียง) ceiling = 6.30 m above porch floor (AR-12 ระดับฝ้า over the double-height porch void).
decisions.effect: Reason: the porch is open to the AR-09 void (โล่ง), so AR-08 shows '-'. AR-12 is the only sheet with a value.

decisions.decision: Columns: the union of all sheets is modelled. ST-04 governs structural columns, so the ST-04-only columns at 2a/A, 2a/B and the carport mid-span y=22.20 are added. Columns on AR-08/AR-09 only are kept as drawn (stair, grid 2/3 posts).
decisions.effect: Reason: structural drawings take precedence for structural members, and a 9.00 m E-F carport span needs the ST-04 mid supports (beams B6+3.70 at y=22.20). Kitchen A' columns are on AR-08 only because no other sheet covers that zone.

decisions.decision: W1 = frame 1.00 x 2.50 per AR-26 (DEC-01 rule).
decisions.effect: The plan opening (~1.5 m) is the masonry opening.
Reason: computed from the bays — D7 bay 10.955-13.455 (2.50 between wall centres, ≈2.40 clear), D7.1 bay 13.455-16.055 (2.60, ≈2.50 clear). This matches the '2.40/2.50' pair on AR-26.
Reason: measured from the vectors on AR-08, AR-09 and ST-04 (16.00 → 17.00). The 1.20 on AR-11 runs to the eave/ramp edge line beyond 5", not to grid 5".

decisions.decision: Entrance porch openings follow the plan: front 2.80, side 1.70.
decisions.effect: Reason: vector-measured gaps between the hatched piers are 2.85 (x 7.57-10.42) and 1.68 (y 13.95-15.63), which match the plan values within 0.05 m. Elevations at 1:75/1:100 are graphic and are used for heights only (Phase 4).

decisions.decision: Section A-A plane at y = 11.90 (AR-08).
decisions.effect: Reason: both lines lie between the stair head (y 9.95) and grid C (13.50), so they cut the same rooms on both floors (living / stair / foyer / reading / treadmill; master / stair / void / bedroom 2). AR-08 carries the primary callout for the section; the 0.65 m shift does not change what AR-11 shows.
